accessibility.evidence: Checked labeled composer and send control, keyboard Enter submission, visible focus styling, semantic request status panel/list and directions list, minimum 44px suggestion targets at all three viewports, and reduced-motion CSS support. Playwright exercised keyboard submission and measured touch target height; no automated screen-reader audit was run.

responsive.evidence: Playwright measured no horizontal overflow at 390x844, 768x1024, and 1440x900 for welcome, conversation, and request-status states. The request-status panel remains above the fixed composer at all three widths; screenshots were visually inspected.

loading.evidence: Playwright held a submitted chat response pending and verified the loading state and Stop control.

empty.evidence: A new guest session asking for request status receives the no-linked-request response, without a fabricated request-status card.

error.evidence: A mocked backend 502 produces bounded recovery guidance; the guest can retry.

partial.evidence: Indoor directions are generated only from configured, guest-visible nodes and edges. Playwright verified Lobby-to-Rooftop-Pool directions and map markers while excluding a hidden Staff Office node. A unit assertion also verifies that a location question without an explicit route does not invent an origin or path; the response asks for a starting point or points to the Front Desk.

success.evidence: The service-request journey required guest confirmation, then showed the backend-confirmed request and its current Received status in structured components.

permission.evidence: Playwright expired the guest session and verified the access recovery message instead of displaying private request data.

renderedEvidence.observation: Compact welcome, wrapped suggestion chips, and integrated composer fit the phone width without horizontal scrolling.
Tablet welcome keeps the conversation as the primary action and maintains centered spacing.
Desktop welcome uses a restrained content width with the composer and contextual prompts as the primary interaction.
Confirmed towel request and Received status remain visible above the composer on a phone.
Structured status card fits tablet layout and does not overlap the fixed composer.
Desktop request status keeps request details, semantic status badge, and composer visually separated.
